# Vendored OCRAD.js

`ocrad.js` is an unmodified copy of
[antimatter15/ocrad.js at commit `503bfe38825d5e9b0c9737866b32a75dea7ed085`](https://github.com/antimatter15/ocrad.js/tree/503bfe38825d5e9b0c9737866b32a75dea7ed085),
dated May 6, 2014. Its Git blob is
`9726a724c5e48be7d28805ac9d688a257ad7ca91`; its SHA-256 is
`3ec7e65b6e11f68e1e68ee6eac4d7292441e6fcb1e802b928f5824e504d867fd`.
The copy was checked byte for byte against that upstream revision.

OCRAD.js is the Emscripten port by Kevin Kwok of GNU Ocrad. This revision
contains the `ocrad-0.23-pre1` C++ source, JavaScript wrappers, and build script.
The upstream repository's license at that revision is GNU GPL version 3;
[`OCRAD-LICENSE.txt`](OCRAD-LICENSE.txt) is its unchanged license text.
This third-party component retains its own license; the ClawGate root MIT
license does not replace it.

## Corresponding upstream source

- [Pinned source tree](https://github.com/antimatter15/ocrad.js/tree/503bfe38825d5e9b0c9737866b32a75dea7ed085)
- [Download the source archive](https://github.com/antimatter15/ocrad.js/archive/503bfe38825d5e9b0c9737866b32a75dea7ed085.tar.gz)
- [Build script](https://github.com/antimatter15/ocrad.js/blob/503bfe38825d5e9b0c9737866b32a75dea7ed085/build.sh)
- [Upstream license](https://github.com/antimatter15/ocrad.js/blob/503bfe38825d5e9b0c9737866b32a75dea7ed085/LICENSE)

The generated JavaScript also retains embedded notices for the Closure
Library's Apache-2.0 code and Tom Wu's permissively licensed code. Preserve
those notices when copying or replacing the artifact.

Keep this directory's license and source information with redistributed
extension copies. Release packaging must also satisfy the applicable source
distribution terms; this provenance notice alone is not a review of the
licensing of a combined release. No upstream rebuild or OCR engine upgrade is
part of this change.
